self_check: batch X (273-284): 1 build (crab SMB, child_cosine 0.6267, q 0.2219). Seven builds now across the session's pivot era (tanker 0.617, hurdy-gurdy 0.610, crab 0.627). The pipeline for a pivot build is now: (1) pivot scan (cases where a seed's neighbour shares a leaf word), (2) word probe to locate the far cluster, (3) cosine check, (4) L12 bridge hunt (a doc containing the pivot word, or a shared-concept doc equidistant from both clusters). Note the environment: the embedder is CPU-starved (~20s/embed) while the all-build runs, so word probes must be one-off and batched; stored-vector operations ($vectorSearch with an existing vector, DB reads) are fast.
